context: A police officer briefs on coordination
purpose: Teach: 市議会/軽量/しくみ/持ち込み/冊子/薬剤師/値下げ/有識者

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 市議会で、防犯条例、検討中です。
lines.en: We're currently reviewing crime prevention ordinances at the city council level.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Clear enunciation. Slight pause between clauses. Steady posture. Not rushed—this is information, not instruction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、軽量装備品も、共有しています。
lines.en: Yes. Our company also shares lightweight safety equipment with the authorities.
lines.style: Respectful, responsive. Leans forward slightly with 'Yes.' Steady pace. Professional but warm. Shows active engagement in the partnership.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 公共のしくみ、住民にも伝えたい。
lines.en: I want to make sure the public understands how this system works.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly earnest. Gentle conviction. Pause before 'how this system works'—he's considering the residents' perspective. Not commanding, explaining.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。資料の持ち込み、警察にも届出しています。
lines.en: Yes. We've already notified the police about materials we're bringing in.
lines.style: Confirming. Straightforward delivery. Pride in the detail—'already notified' carries a light emphasis. Efficient, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 防犯冊子、全戸配布、進めています。
lines.en: Crime prevention booklets are being distributed to every household.
lines.style: Official update tone. Steady pace. Even weight across the sentence. Matter-of-fact but not cold. This is progress being reported.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。薬剤師、警察連絡網にも入ってます。
lines.en: Yes. Pharmacists are included in the police communication network as well.
lines.style: Affirming. 'As well' carries light emphasis—showing the breadth of coordination. Calm confidence. No defensiveness, just showing scope.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 業界の値下げ、安全性に響く時、警戒します。
lines.en: When industry cost-cutting starts to compromise safety, that's when we need to be alert.
lines.style: Serious shift. Measured but with underlying concern. Slight weight on 'safety.' Not alarmist—careful. Eyes level, speaking from experience.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。有識者の声、警察にも届けています。
lines.en: Yes. We're making sure expert opinions reach the police as well.
lines.style: Reassuring. 'Making sure' has quiet determination. Professional, warm undertone. The kind of affirmation that says 'we're all on the same side here.'
